description: Replace scripts/fullstack-layer-test.sh with a massively expanded 1000+ test version covering all 9 architectural pillars across 18+ layers with granular endpoint testing, security tests, performance assertions, concurrency tests, and edge case coverage for every API route in the system.
steps: Replace the entire scripts/fullstack-layer-test.sh file with a new comprehensive version that preserves the same CLI interface (--help, --dry-run, --layer N, --quick) and env var configuration (BASE_URL, FRONTEND_URL, TEST_JWT_TOKEN, TEST_TURNSTILE_TOKEN, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD, RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, CRON_SECRET, VERBOSE, STRESS_TEST, EXPORT_JSON, SKIP_AUTH_TESTS, SKIP_ADMIN_TESTS)

Keep the same utility functions: pass(), fail(), warn(), skip(), verbose_log(), section_header(), perform_request(), perform_stream_request(), has_header(), get_header_value(), json_field(), is_json(). Keep the same state tracking (TOTAL_TESTS, PASSED_TESTS, etc.), color output, argument parsing, and JSON export

LAYER 0 (Prerequisites): Expand to ~15 tests - check curl version, jq version, openssl, bash version >= 4, DNS resolution test to BASE_URL, DNS resolution test to FRONTEND_URL, connectivity pre-check (HEAD request), validate URL format (no trailing slash), validate env vars are non-empty when provided, check for conflicting options, validate --layer range, token format validation (JWT structure), test tmp file creation, test jq filter execution

LAYER 1 (Frontend/CDN): Expand to ~50 tests - page load with timing assertions (<3s), HTTP/2 check, content-encoding (gzip/br/deflate each), robots.txt content validation (disallow patterns), sitemap link in robots.txt, all security headers individually (HSTS with max-age check, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff exactly, X-Frame-Options value, CSP header, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy), HTML structure validation (DOCTYPE, html lang, meta charset, meta viewport, title tag, OG tags), favicon accessibility, manifest.json, static asset cache-control (immutable, max-age > 1 year for hashed assets), 404 page handling, trailing slash redirect behavior, case sensitivity test, query parameter pass-through, unicode URL handling, response size reasonableness, no server version leak, cookie secure/httponly flags if any set

LAYER 2 (Edge Worker): Expand to ~80 tests - /health response fields (backend_reachable, timestamp, version), /health timing (<500ms), /health/full all fields, CORS preflight for every method (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS), CORS with multiple origins (frontend, evil origin, null origin, no origin), Access-Control-Allow-Headers includes all expected headers, Access-Control-Max-Age, Access-Control-Allow-Credentials, X-Request-ID format (UUID), X-Request-ID uniqueness (two requests get different IDs), bot detection with various User-Agents (Googlebot, Bingbot, curl, python-requests, empty UA, normal Chrome), rate limit headers on chat (x-ratelimit-limit, x-ratelimit-remaining, x-ratelimit-reset format), HSTS on API responses, X-Content-Type-Options on API, Content-Type: application/json on health endpoints, hop-by-hop headers stripped (Connection, Keep-Alive, Transfer-Encoding not leaked), X-Real-IP header injection test, request with oversized headers, request with many headers, path traversal attempts (/../), null byte injection in URL, double encoding detection

LAYER 3 (Backend Health): Expand to ~40 tests - /health response time (<1000ms), /health JSON structure (status field, timestamp), /health/deep individual service checks (mongodb, redis, vertex_ai, sarvam_ai, each as separate test), /health/circuit-breakers individual CB states (vertex_ai, sarvam_ai, vertex_search each), /health response cache-control (no-cache for health), content-type validation, /health with Accept header variations, /health with query params (should still work), /health idempotency (same response structure on repeated calls), /api/v1/health if exists, method not allowed (PUT/DELETE on /health should fail), empty body handling

LAYER 4 (Authentication): Expand to ~100 tests - signup with every invalid field combination (empty email, invalid email formats like 'user@', 'user@.com', '@domain.com', spaces in email, SQL injection in email, XSS in name, password too short, password no uppercase, password no number, password no special char, missing required fields one at a time, extra unexpected fields, null values, integer where string expected, array where string expected, empty JSON body, non-JSON body, oversized body >1MB), login validation (same input fuzzing), login with wrong password returns same error as wrong email (no user enumeration), login timing attack resistance (both wrong user and wrong password take similar time), refresh with malformed JWT, refresh with expired JWT structure, refresh with JWT signed by wrong key, forgot-password email enumeration prevention (same response for existing/non-existing), forgot-password rate limiting, reset-password with invalid/expired token, logout with valid token, logout with already-expired token, logout idempotency, token structure validation (3 parts, base64url), authorization header format variations (Bearer vs bearer vs BEARER, extra spaces, no Bearer prefix, empty token, token with spaces)

LAYER 5 (Chat): Expand to ~90 tests - POST /api/v1/chat/ without auth (verify behavior), with auth English (response fields: response/text, model_used, latency_ms, sources), with auth Assamese (Sarvam routing, response in Assamese script), empty message handling, very long message (>10000 chars), message with only whitespace, message with unicode/emoji, message with HTML tags (XSS attempt), message with script tags, message with SQL injection, missing message field, missing language field, invalid language code, null message, content-type validation (non-JSON), malformed JSON body, streaming endpoint content-type check (text/event-stream), SSE data: line format, SSE done event, SSE metadata in final event, GET /api/v1/chat/history (empty array for new user, array structure, pagination params), GET /api/v1/chat/{session_id}/messages (valid format, 404 for nonexistent), chat/conversations legacy alias, POST /api/v1/chat/image (without file, with wrong content-type, with oversized file), POST /api/v1/chat/tts (valid request, invalid params), concurrent chat requests, response time assertions (<10s for non-streaming), streaming first-byte-time assertion

LAYER 6 (RAG/Search): Expand to ~35 tests - circuit breaker state check, chat with factual question (sources field present/absent), source object structure (title, url, snippet), source relevance (non-empty text), RAG fallback when circuit breaker open, chat with nonsense query (graceful handling), chat with very specific curriculum query, response grounding indicator, search latency contribution, multiple sequential RAG queries (consistency)

LAYER 7 (Content): Expand to ~55 tests - /api/v1/content/library-bundle (full response structure, boards array, each board has required fields), library-bundle?slim=1 (smaller payload, same structure), /api/v1/content/render/{board}/{class}/{subject}/{chapter} with valid/invalid combinations, content slug lookup (valid slug, invalid slug, empty slug, slug with special chars), subject chapters endpoint, content with Accept-Language header, content caching headers (ETag, Last-Modified, Cache-Control), conditional request (If-None-Match returns 304), content-type is application/json, response compression, chapters/{id}/faq-jsonld structure, chapters/{id}/published-topics, pagination on content lists, empty result handling, large content response handling

LAYER 8 (Payments): Expand to ~70 tests - GET /api/v1/subscription/plans (plan structure validation, each plan has name/price/features), plans caching, GET /api/v1/subscription/status with auth (tier, limits, renewal_date fields), POST /api/v1/payments/create-order (valid plan, invalid plan, empty plan, plan with XSS), POST /api/v1/payments/verify with invalid signatures (empty sig, short sig, wrong format, replayed sig), POST /api/v1/payments/recover, POST /api/v1/payments/credit-topup (valid credits, credits=0, credits=-1, credits=9999, non-integer), POST /api/v1/payments/credit-topup/verify, GET /api/v1/payments/history (array structure, pagination), POST /api/v1/payments/refund-request, all payment endpoints without auth (should 401), payment endpoints with expired token, content-type enforcement on POST endpoints, idempotency on verify, race condition on double-verify

LAYER 9 (Webhooks): Expand to ~50 tests - POST /api/webhooks/razorpay without signature, with empty signature, with invalid HMAC, with wrong algorithm, with truncated signature, with valid HMAC (using RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET), event types (payment.captured, payment.failed, subscription.activated, subscription.cancelled, refund.created each separately), webhook with missing event field, webhook with missing payload, webhook with extra fields (should not fail), webhook idempotency (same event_id twice), webhook with empty body, webhook with non-JSON body, webhook with oversized body, replay attack (old timestamp if timestamp checked), Content-Type enforcement, webhook response time (<5s), concurrent webhook delivery, webhook with unknown event type (should 200 or ignore gracefully)

LAYER 10 (Conversations): Expand to ~60 tests - GET /api/v1/conversations (list, pagination: page/limit params, default limit, max limit, invalid page number, negative page), anon conversations (valid anon-id, empty anon-id, anon-id with special chars, very long anon-id, anon-id with spaces, SQL injection in anon-id), GET /api/v1/conversations/anon/{id} (valid, invalid, nonexistent), DELETE /api/v1/conversations/anon/{id}, GET /api/v1/conversations/{id} (own conversation, nonexistent, someone else's), DELETE /api/v1/conversations/{id} (own, nonexistent, idempotent delete), PATCH /api/v1/conversations/{id} (valid title, empty title, title with XSS, title too long, invalid JSON, wrong content-type), all conversation endpoints without auth, list sorting/ordering

LAYER 11 (Feedback): Expand to ~40 tests - POST /api/v1/chat/feedback/ (valid feedback all fields, minimal fields, rating=1 boundary, rating=5 boundary, rating=0 invalid, rating=6 invalid, rating=-1, rating=null, missing session_id, missing rating, empty comment, very long comment >5000 chars, comment with XSS, comment with unicode/emoji, duplicate feedback submission, feedback without auth), GET /api/v1/chat/feedback/stats (admin only check, response structure, non-admin gets 403), feedback with invalid session_id format, feedback with invalid message_id

LAYER 12 (Admin): Expand to ~100 tests - ALL admin endpoints without auth (should 401/403): dashboard, users, analytics, content, settings, security, seo, revenue, ai, alerts, dead-letters, knowledge, notifications, translate, conversations. WITH admin auth: GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard (response structure: total_users, active_today, revenue, etc.), GET /api/v1/admin/users (list, pagination, search), PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/{id}/status, PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/{id}/plan, PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/{id}/role, PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/{id}/credits, GET /api/v1/admin/analytics (daily, revenue, predictor, cf-status, cf-overview, bot-traffic, hydrate-stats, review-prompt-stats, content-card-views), GET /api/v1/admin/settings, PUT /api/v1/admin/settings (with valid/invalid data), GET /api/v1/admin/diagnostics, GET /api/v1/admin/roadmap, GET /api/v1/admin/plan-config, GET /api/v1/admin/api-config, GET /api/v1/admin/activity-log, security endpoints (spoofed-bots, blocked-ips, block-trends, block-ip, unblock-ip, ttl-monitor, collection-size-history), SEO endpoints (entity/status, history, pipeline-status, coverage, deep-scan-history), revenue endpoints (overview, subscriptions), AI endpoints (providers, status), alerts (unacknowledged/count, cooldowns), dead-letters list, notifications (list, create), translate endpoints, admin conversations

LAYER 13 (SEO): Expand to ~45 tests - sitemap.xml (valid XML, contains urlset, has URLs, valid URL format), sitemap-static.xml, sitemap-subjects.xml, sitemap-chapters.xml, sitemap-topics.xml, sitemap-index if exists, /feed.xml (valid RSS/Atom, has entries, correct content-type: application/xml), /feed/{subject}.xml, /feed.json (valid JSON feed), content-type headers on each, caching headers on sitemaps, IndexNow submit (valid URL array, empty array, invalid URLs, too many URLs, non-array body, auth requirement), IndexNow with single URL, response time on sitemaps (<2s), sitemap size reasonableness, no broken internal links in sitemap (spot check)

LAYER 14 (Education): Expand to ~30 tests - /api/v1/edu/quiz/{subject} (each expected subject, nonexistent subject, empty subject), /api/v1/edu/notes/{subject}, /api/v1/edu/flashcards/{subject}, /api/v1/edu/settings, /api/v1/edu/sync, /api/v1/edu/voice/{session_id}, all edu endpoints method validation, education with auth vs without auth, path traversal in subject param, SQL injection in subject param, unicode in subject param

LAYER 15 (Rate Limiting): Expand to ~40 tests - rate limit headers present (x-ratelimit-limit is numeric, x-ratelimit-remaining is numeric and <= limit, x-ratelimit-reset is valid timestamp), rate limit on chat (English), rate limit on chat (Assamese - separate quota), rate limit header consistency across requests, rate limit decrement verification (remaining goes down), 429 response body structure (error message, retry-after), rate limit on auth endpoints (login, signup, forgot-password), rate limit reset timing, rate limit per-user isolation (different tokens get independent limits), stress test (configurable: 30-50 rapid requests until 429), rate limit bypass attempts (X-Forwarded-For spoofing, different User-Agents), rate limit on admin endpoints

LAYER 16 (Streaming/SSE): Expand to ~35 tests - content-type text/event-stream, Transfer-Encoding chunked or absent, SSE format (data: prefix on each line), SSE JSON parse each data line, SSE first event timing (<3s), SSE final event has done:true, SSE metadata (model, latency_ms, lang), no empty data lines between events, SSE with English, SSE with Assamese, SSE error handling (invalid token mid-stream), SSE connection timeout handling, SSE with very long response, SSE event count > 0, streaming without auth behavior, cache-control: no-cache on stream responses

LAYER 17 (E2E Workflows): Expand to ~60 tests - Workflow 1 New User: signup -> login -> get profile -> chat -> get history -> feedback -> logout (each step verified). Workflow 2 Subscription: login -> get plans -> check status -> create order -> verify (invalid) -> check status unchanged. Workflow 3 Anonymous: anon chat -> anon history -> verify conversation created. Workflow 4 Content Discovery: library-bundle -> pick subject -> get chapters -> render content. Workflow 5 Admin: admin login -> dashboard -> users list -> user detail -> analytics -> settings. Workflow 6 Multi-language: English chat -> Assamese chat -> verify both in history. Workflow 7 Token Lifecycle: login -> use token -> wait -> refresh -> use new token. Workflow 8 Error Recovery: invalid request -> correct request -> verify no state pollution

LAYER 18 (Cross-Cutting): Expand to ~80 tests - X-Request-ID on every major endpoint (health, chat, auth, content, payments - each checked), X-Request-ID is UUID format, X-API-Version on responses, CORS from frontend origin (all endpoints), CORS from evil origin (blocked or restricted), CSRF protection (wrong origin on state-changing endpoints), content-type enforcement (non-JSON on POST endpoints), method not allowed (GET on POST-only, POST on GET-only for major endpoints), 404 handling (unknown paths return JSON error not HTML), 404 response structure, path traversal prevention, SQL injection in URL params, XSS in query params, oversized request body (>5MB), empty request body on POST, duplicate headers handling, HTTP method case sensitivity, URL path case sensitivity, trailing slash normalization, query param injection, header injection (CRLF), Unicode normalization in paths, response compression (Accept-Encoding: gzip), no stack traces in error responses, no internal IPs in responses, no server version headers, timing consistency (no timing-based info leaks), concurrent request handling (10 parallel requests succeed), idempotency of GET requests, cache headers on dynamic vs static content

LAYER 19 (Users API - NEW): Add ~40 tests - GET /api/v1/users/me (profile structure, all expected fields), PUT /api/v1/users/me (valid update, invalid fields, XSS in name, empty name, oversized name, SQL injection), DELETE /api/v1/users/me (requires auth, returns confirmation), POST /api/v1/users/onboarding (valid data, invalid data, already onboarded), GET /api/v1/users/credits (credit balance structure), all user endpoints without auth (401), user endpoints with expired token, PATCH-like behavior on PUT, concurrent profile updates

LAYER 20 (Performance/Timing - NEW): Add ~30 tests - response time assertions on every major endpoint class (health <500ms, auth <2s, chat <10s, content <3s, payments <3s, admin <3s, SEO <2s), TTFB assertions, DNS time assertions, TLS handshake time assertions, payload size assertions (health <5KB, library-bundle <500KB), streaming first-byte vs total time, concurrent load test (5 parallel requests all succeed within 15s), cold start detection (first vs second request timing)

Ensure the main() function dispatches all layers including the new 19 and 20, updates the --help text to show layers 0-20, updates the --layer case statement, adds the new layers to the all-layers run sequence
Final test count verification: The script should contain at minimum 1000 individual pass()/fail()/warn()/skip() calls across all layers combined (count all assertion calls in the script)
Keep the script syntactically valid bash (must pass bash -n check) and maintain the set -euo pipefail safety
